decision.reason: The only prose, [ev-0eb3d16492e3], is a troubleshooting entry. It quotes an error message and says to use 0.16.1 instead of 0.16.0. It does not name what changed in 0.16.0 or how, and the section context adds nothing more. The rendered diffs ([ev-558ba9e85f76], [ev-7a082965d61c], [ev-728cc9a57b79] and others) show that the Webhook conversion block was removed from spec.conversion on about 20 chart CRDs. No source links that removal to the Forbidden error, though, and treating it as the cause would be a guess. To fill the subject and change aspects, we need upstream text (for example the PR, the 0.16.1 fix notes or an upgrade-guide section) that names the changed CRD conversion setting and says how it changed.
